Sky Sports analyses the decisions from Xabi Alonso that contributed to Chelsea's 3-2 defeat to Nottingham Forest; Wesley Fofana started despite his controversial interview, while Levi Colwill was dropped; Xabi Alonso called for fundamentals but Chelsea were outrun
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Xabi Alonso called for his Chelsea side to get back to the fundamentals before kick-off - and then watched on as they were outworked and outclassed on their way to a miserable 3-2 defeat at Nottingham Forest.
"Everyone in the club and team, we need to stick together and go through this moment. We have to deal with it and we are responsible," Alonso told Sky Sports after the game, which marked their third successive defeat in the Premier League.
"It is a difficult moment for everyone at the club. For the team and the fans. Disappointed to lose again but we need to keep trying to find solutions.
"We can't stop. We are low in confidence. At this level you need to hold results and not concede so much. That is why we are losing."
Alonso now has as many losses in 15 games across all competitions as he did in 34 for Real Madrid (6). Since March, no side has more defeats in the top-flight than the Blues (14). And their problems are mounting by the day.
Here, Sky Sports analyses the decisions that contributed to the worrying defeat at the City Ground.
Despite the calls from Alonso to strip the game back to basics and get the fundamentals right, Chelsea felt short from minute one.
At the half-time interval, facing a 1-0 deficit and with zero shots on target, Chelsea had ran 3.8km less than Oliver Glasner's side.
The Forest boss was then quick to point out that they had outrun their opponents by 6km after the game. Yes, Chelsea had more possession, but they were also well behind in high-speed runs.
"I've seen one team jogging after the ball and one team sprinting after the ball and in this day and age, you cannot do that," said Jamie Redknapp.
"Distance covered is not always the barometer, but one thing is for sure, high-speed runs will tell you everything."
Starting Wesley Fofana in the same week the player had to apologise for his controversial interview, where he said he can "laugh about" the penalty miss that contributed to their Carabao Cup exit to Liverpool and contemplated retirement during injury spells at the club, was a bold move from Alonso. It did not pay off.
The tone was set early on. Fofana's first touches were heavily booed by the travelling Chelsea fans who had made the 130-mile journey in the cold and rain to watch their side slip to yet another dismal defeat.
The centre-back could only watch on as Igor Jesus volleyed in his stunning opener but was at the centre of attention, for all the wrong reasons, for the second.
After misjudging the ball while battling with former teammate Liam Delap, who caused problems all evening, Fofana rushed to atone for his error and fouled the striker in the penalty area.
Morgan Gibbs-White doubled the lead from the spot and ultimately the comeback, led by substitute Emmanuel Emegha, fell short.
He was cautioned for the challenge and eventually taken off for Levi Colwill, who was dropped by Alonso instead of Fofana, and the fans booed him once again.
"It didn't feel like a game for him tonight. He had a bad week with the podcast," said Jamie Redknapp after the game.
"By playing Fofana tonight, you created that. It was inevitable. He is lacking so much confidence; he needs some time.
After making the decision to drop Colwill, options at the centre of defence were limited with Maxence Lacroix and Reece James both sidelined.
Playing Josh Acheampong at centre-back and giving a rare start to Malo Gusto, an unused substitute on the night, seemed the more obvious choice but Alonso opted to play Moises Caicedo, arguably the best midfielder in the league, in the back four instead.
He was then tasked with dealing with a strike partnership of Delap and Igor Jesus. A difficult task for even the tallest of centre-backs, let alone a makeshift one standing at 5-foot-10.
He gave space to the Brazil striker for the opener and his presence in midfield was missed. He still led the way with 114 passes on the night, but Chelsea needed him in the middle of the park to deal with the likes of James McAtee and Xaver Schlager.
"They have bought players but if they do not sign a centre back, they cannot compete," said Redknapp after the game. He is right.
Alonso admitted that Emegha's performance after scoring twice off the bench was the lone positive for his side to take from their trip to the East Midlands. "For sure, he is having a good impact," he said. "He has done well. That is a positive."
He scored his first goal in the 4-1 defeat to Leeds United last time out but lost his place in the starting line-up on Friday.
Danny Welbeck, 36, was given the nod ahead of him and his performance mirrored the struggles Chelsea had as a unit.
Alonso called on the experience of Jordan Henderson and Welbeck to help weather their current struggles but it only whipped up the storm.
Welbeck was a bystander in the first half and had just seven touches before being replaced at the break, Emegha then scored with his first two to help spark hopes of a comeback.
His header for the second, holding off Jair Cunha, was one of the rare moments Chelsea matched the physicality of their opponents. He has to start moving forward without Joao Pedro available.
Alonso said the only way he knows how to address these issues is to attack them on the training ground. He has just five days to do that before they are put to the test against Crystal Palace, live on Sky Sports, who will be desperate for a win.

texts.https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/art:
Cole Palmer left the City Ground without having a shot or a touch in the opposition box as Chelsea lost 3-2 at Nottingham Forest on Friday night.
The 24-year-old forward started the season by registering six goal involvements in his first six league games (two goals and four assists), with his penalty against Manchester United now his only goal contribution in the past six matches.
Last weekend, after his side were booed off following the 4-1 defeat by Leeds United , Palmer appeared reluctant to take part in the customary post-match acknowledgement of the supporters.
On his way off the pitch, he appeared to ignore the club's player support and development officer Willie Isa, a former Wigan Warriors rugby league player, whose role includes helping to ensure that acknowledgement takes place regardless of the result.
Palmer was then seen in a heated exchange with injured striker Joao Pedro as he headed down the tunnel.
His visible frustration comes during a difficult period for Chelsea under new manager Xabi Alonso.
Chelsea have lost their past three games and conceded 23 goals, their highest total after 12 matches since the 2015-16 season, with Alonso facing criticism for the leaky defence and constant line-up changes .
One positive had been the attack, with Chelsea scoring 18 times in six matches, largely because of the link-up play between Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Joao Pedro.
Club-record signing Rogers, who cost £117m in the summer, has also become less effective, while Pedro remains sidelined by a groin injury.
But some observers argue Palmer needs to step up to help lift his team out of this difficult period.
It is nearly two years since he produced the form of his life, breaking Chelsea 's record with 39 goal involvements (26 goals and 13 assists) in the 2024 calendar year.
There are no concerns about Palmer's attitude or behaviour internally at Chelsea .
Senior sources inside the club say he has been ultra-focused behind the scenes, doing extra sessions and he is described as a "leader" by Alonso.
In mid-April, deep into a dismal campaign in which Chelsea finished 10th having had three different managers, rumours were rife he was pining for a return to Manchester, with United - a club he still supports - linked.
When speaking to the Guardian, he added: "All my family are there, but I don't miss it. Maybe I'll miss it if I don't go for three months or something. But then when I get home I think there's nothing there for me anyway. I've got no plans to move from Chelsea ."
A move to United was never seriously explored by any of those involved and Palmer re-established his commitment to Chelsea by signing a lucrative deal until 2034.
It made him among the club's highest-paid players and followed similar deals for Reece James, Moises Caicedo and Joao Pedro.
Palmer's mother, father and girlfriend were all present in the directors' box against Bournemouth after he signed the new deal.
Like the others who have recently renewed, Palmer has been reassured by the sporting leadership team that Chelsea are ambitious, out to win trophies and have learned from past mistakes, hiring a high-calibre manager in Alonso and signing three over-30 players for the first time in four years to add experience to their squad.
That said, Palmer has not hit the heights of his first 18 months under former manager Mauricio Pochettino, now in charge of Manchester United , and then early into Enzo Maresca's reign.
Having been nicknamed "Cold" Palmer after his goal celebration, where he shrugs his shoulders and pretends to be cold, his decline began in early 2025.
A persistent groin problem affected his form as the goals and assists began to dry up. Even so, Palmer produced man-of-the-match displays in the Conference League and Club World Cup finals to maintain his reputation as a big-game player.
He did not fully overcome the injury heading into the following season and his return of 10 goals and one assist in 25 matches represented a significant drop in output.
In a candid pre-season interview , Palmer explained: "The first few months, with me being injured, I just wanted to go out and play, which I probably shouldn't have done.
"Obviously I couldn't play how I wanted to play. It was a bad season personally with injuries but I feel good now."
He added the impact on how he wanted to play affected his ability to move on the pitch and strike the ball with power.
Over the summer, he was said by multiple sources close to him and inside Chelsea to have been bitterly disappointed to have missed out on the World Cup squad.
It has been further impacted by criticism from manager Thomas Tuchel, who said he "misses too many opportunities" to play for the Three Lions.
Sources at Stamford Bridge also reiterated Alonso's assertion that Palmer was unavailable throughout the extended England camp because of a muscle injury.
It was highlighted by the fact he did not take part in a behind-closed-doors friendly against Portsmouth towards the end of the break.
Palmer was then not selected for the following camp in November, but multiple sources say he remains fully committed to regaining his place in the national team.
Team-mate Rogers told BBC Sport it was "a lie" that Palmer does not want to play for England , while another of his best friends in football, Tosin Adarabioyo, called it "false, false, false".
Former Manchester City and Chelsea defender Tosin, now at Tottenham , is known to have called him a "little superstar", and Palmer has found fame difficult to cope with at times.
The Wythenshawe-born forward is mobbed whenever he leaves Stamford Bridge, while he has posted pictures going out in a balaclava to try to live as normal a life as possible.
Chelsea fan Savage Dan thinks Cole Palmer's inconsistency is 'an issue'
Lastly, there is the question of whether the Chelsea project itself could be impacting him.
The club's use of ultra-long contracts has attracted criticism from some commentators and external sources, who have questioned whether such deals can affect motivation once a player's future is secured.
Critics also argue such contracts may reduce a player's leverage if they later seek a move away.
There is little evidence to support that argument in individual cases, such as Palmer's, but contracts of that length remain rare elsewhere in English football.
Chelsea maintain their deals are heavily incentivised, with significant elements linked to individual and collective performance.
Ultimately, Palmer is one of many Chelsea players struggling, with teams adapting to deal with his threat and he has lost Joao Pedro, with whom he had a fantastic connection .
However, he has the influence to positively affect his team-mates as one of the poster boys for the club and carries the weight of helping his team arrest their downturn.
It now looks as though Palmer's success or failure is completely intertwined with Chelsea 's fortunes, given he will likely remain at the club for a long time to come.
The Blues have shown belief in coaxing Palmer's extraordinary performances of 2024 back out of him and, should that be realised, it would go a long way towards reviving Alonso's side.

Goals to Alanna Kennedy and Caitlin Foord capped off a 3-1 win
Steph Catley has celebrated her 150th appearance for Australia in style, playing a key role in the Matildas’ go-ahead goal as they kicked away in the second half to secure a 3-1 win over Colombia.
After Alanna Kennedy and Linda Caicedo netted inside the opening 15 minutes, Catley’s 59th-minute corner ricocheted off Daniela Arias’s back to put Australia into the ascendancy, before Caitlin Foord struck three minutes later to secure a match-winning cushion.
The defender had donned the armband for her milestone appearance at a wet GIO Stadium on Saturday night, with Joe Montemurro also fielding the returning Mary Fowler and Kyra Cooney-Cross in his XI – the latter making her first Matildas appearance in 252 days.
Chasing continuity and insight ahead of the Women’s World Cup next June, the coach will get another chance to look at his side – and chase a final win in 2026 – next Wednesday, when the two sides meet in Geelong.
Augering a breakneck opening in Canberra, Fowler sprung Ellie Carpenter into space just seconds in, with her resulting cross sent back across the face of goal by Foord before being redirected just wide by Sam Kerr.
Caicedo flashed a shot across the face of goal as the South Americans looked for an immediate response, with Foord and Colombia’s Ingrid Guerra also having chances amid the back-and-forth exchanges.
But the Matildas suited this blistering pace, and they produced arguably the best-worked goal of Montemurro’s tenure in the tenth minute as Clare Wheeler, Fowler, Kerr, and Kennedy combined to slice the visitor’s defence to ribbons on their way to the opening goal.
Falling behind, though, seemed to spur Caicedo on; the Real Madrid star almost equalising moments after the restart and then finding the net in the 15th minute after bursting forward, blowing past Winonah Heatley and converting.
Every time the 21-year-old got near the ball, alarm bells rang for the Matildas, with her combination of pace, close control and positional nous leaving defenders scrambling – a 20th-minute assist denied by Gisela Robledo’s offside kneecap.
But Montemurro’s adjustments at halftime – which saw Kerr withdrawn for Hayley Raso – put the clamps on the South Americans, who didn’t produce another shot until Manuela Vanegas’s 94th-minute header.
Catley’s set piece and Foord’s strike, the latter the result of class build-up from Fowler and Cooney-Cross, then served to secure an assured result.

Gençlik ve Spor Bakanı Osman Aşkın Bak, İstanbul'da "Tuzla Belediyesi Spor Kompleksi Temel Atma Töreni"nde konuşuyor.
Tüpraş Stadı'nda oynanacak önemli müsabaka öncesinde Galatasaray'ın tecrübeli çalıştırıcısı Okan Buruk'un derbi karnesi mercek altına alındı.
Süper Lig'de son 4 sezonu şampiyon tamamlayan sarı-kırmızılı ekip, Okan Buruk yönetiminde derbilerde başarılı bir performans ortaya koydu. 53 yaşındaki teknik direktör, Galatasaray'ın başında olduğu süreçte Beşiktaş ve Fenerbahçe'ye karşı çıktığı 21 resmi maçta 12 galibiyet, 4 beraberlik ve 5 mağlubiyet yaşadı.
Okan Buruk yönetimindeki Galatasaray, Beşiktaş'a karşı derbilerde üstünlük sağladı.
Buruk'un öğrencileri, siyah-beyazlılara karşı 8 lig ve 1 TFF Süper Kupa müsabakasına çıktı.
Siyah-beyazlılara karşı 5 galibiyet, 1 beraberlik ile 3 mağlubiyet yaşayan Okan Buruk yönetimindeki Galatasaray, bu maçlarda 11 kez ağları sarstı ve 14 golü kalesinde gördü.
Geçtiğimiz sezonlarda sarı-kırmızılılarla birçok başarıya imza atan Buruk, Beşiktaş'a karşı kazanması halinde yeni bir rekora ortak olacak.
Okan Buruk, pazartesi günü siyah-beyazlıları mağlup etmesi halinde Beşiktaş'a karşı Süper Lig'deki 3. deplasman galibiyetini alacak. Tecrübeli çalıştırıcı böylece Galatasaray tarihinde Gündüz Kılıç ile beraber ligde Beşiktaş'ı dış sahada en fazla yenen teknik direktör olacak.
Buruk, Galatasaray tarihinde Gündüz Kılıç ile birlikte Beşiktaş'ı Süper Lig'de en fazla mağlup eden ikinci teknik adam konumunda bulunuyor.
Sarı-kırmızılıların başına geçtiğinden beri siyah-beyazlıları Süper Lig'de 5 kez mağlup eden Buruk, bu alanda Gündüz Kılıç (5) ile aynı sırayı paylaşıyor. Tecrübeli teknik adam, pazartesi günü kazanması halinde Kılıç'ı geride bırakarak tek başına ikinci sırayı alacak.
Türk futbolunun efsanesi Fatih Terim ise 10 galibiyetle Galatasaray'ın teknik direktörü olarak Beşiktaş'ı ligde en fazla mağlup eden isim olarak zirvede yer alıyor.
Okan Buruk, Galatasaray'ın başına geçtikten sonra Beşiktaş ve Fenerbahçe ile Süper Lig'de oynadığı derbilerde 10 farklı teknik adamla karşılaştı.
Tecrübeli çalıştırıcı, sarı-kırmızılılarla ligdeki Beşiktaş derbilerinde teknik adamlardan Şenol Güneş, Burak Yılmaz, Fernando Santos, Giovanni van Bronckhorst, Ole Gunnar Solskjaer ve Sergen Yalçın'a karşı maça çıktı.
Ayrıca Buruk, Galatasaray'ın başındayken Süper Lig'de Fenerbahçe'nin teknik direktörleri Jorge Jesus, Jose Mourinho, Domenico Tedesco ve İsmail Kartal ile derbi müsabakalarında karşılaştı.
Buruk'un ligdeki derbilerde karşılaşacağı 11. isim Vincenzo Italiano olacak.
Okan Buruk, Galatasaray'ın başında 12 Fenerbahçe derbisine çıktı.
Altyapısından yetiştiği ve futbolcu olarak büyük başarılar elde ettiği Galatasaray'a 2022-2023 sezonunun başında geçen Buruk, sarı-kırmızılı takımın başında Fenerbahçe'ye karşı 9 lig, 2 TFF Süper Kupa ve 1 Ziraat Türkiye Kupası maçı oynadı. Buruk yönetimindeki Galatasaray, bu dönemde sarı-lacivertlilere karşı 7 galibiyet (biri hükmen), 3 beraberlik ve 2 mağlubiyet yaşadı.
Bu müsabakalarda 20 gol kaydeden (3'ü hükmen galibiyetten) Buruk yönetimindeki Galatasaray, 7 kez topu ağlarından çıkardı.
Okan Buruk, Galatasaray haricinde Beşiktaş'a 12 kez rakip oldu.
Geçmişte Elazığspor, Gaziantepspor, Sivasspor, Akhisarspor, Çaykur Rizespor ve İstanbul Başakşehir'in teknik direktörlüğünü yapan Okan Buruk, bu takımların başında Beşiktaş'la 12 kez karşılaştı.
Tecrübeli teknik adam, söz konusu müsabakalarda 8 kez mağlup olurken 3 kez de berabere kaldı. Okan Buruk, Galatasaray haricindeki tek Beşiktaş galibiyetini Süper Lig'in 2019-2020 sezonunun 22. haftasında İstanbul Başakşehir'in teknik direktörlüğünü yaparken takımının sahasında 1-0 kazandığı maçla aldı.
Beşiktaş Teknik Direktörü Vincenzo Italiano, siyah-beyazlılardaki ikinci derbisine Okan Buruk'un yönetimindeki Galatasaray karşısında çıkacak.
Sezon başında Beşiktaş'ın teknik direktörlük görevine getirilen 48 yaşındaki İtalyan çalıştırıcı, siyah-beyazlılarla çıktığı ilk derbi maçında konuk olduğu Fenerbahçe'yi ligin 4. haftasında 2-1 yendi.

Netflix dizisi Rise of Empires: Ottoman'da Fatih Sultan Mehmed'i canlandıran Cem Yiğit Üzümoğlu, Kazım Koyuncu'ya hayat verdiği "Kazım: Yarım Kalan" filmi için aylar süren bir hazırlıktan geçti. Oyuncu, sıkı bir diyet ve kondisyon programıyla tam 19 kilo verdi.
Üzümoğlu'nun dönüşümü kilo vermekle sınırlı kalmadı. Kazım Koyuncu'nun kendine özgü gülüşünü ve ağız yapısını yakalayabilmek için oyuncuya, filmde canlandırdığı farklı yaş dönemlerine göre tasarlanan 10 ayrı özel diş hazırlandı.
Milliyet'in aktardığına göre sanatçının farklı yıllardaki yüz hatlarını ve saç yapısını perdeye taşımak için yapılan saç ve özel plastik makyaj uygulamaları, bazı set günlerinde dört saatten uzun sürdü. Üzümoğlu, gitar ve sahne duruşu çalışmalarını da Kazım Koyuncu'nun üniversite yıllarından arkadaşı olan ve ona gitar dersi vermiş olan Deniz Bayrak ile yürüttü.
Ödüllü yönetmen Özcan Alper'in çektiği film, Karadeniz ve Laz ezgilerini rock müzikle buluşturan Kazım Koyuncu'nun yaşamından esinleniyor. İstanbul, Artvin ve Rize'de çekilen filmin 8 haftalık çekimleri ekim ayında tamamlanmıştı. Fragmanın yayınlanmasının ardından oyuncunun karaktere dönüşümü merak konusu oldu. Film 1 Ocak'ta sinemalarda izleyiciyle buluşacak.
Filmin kadrosunda Üzümoğlu'nun yanı sıra Şifanur Gül, Serra Arıtürk, Aslıhan Kapanşahin, Ayça Bingöl, Fikret Kuşkan, Taner Birsel ve Şevval Sam da yer alıyor.
1994 doğumlu Üzümoğlu, Hacettepe Üniversitesi Ankara Devlet Konservatuvarı oyunculuk bölümünden mezun oldu. Televizyondaki ilk rolünü 2017'de Kanal D'de yayımlanan Adı Efsane dizisinde üstlenen oyuncu, ardından Netflix'in ilk Türk dizisi Hakan: Muhafız'da rol aldı. Üzümoğlu, bu yıl 63. Uluslararası Antalya Altın Portakal Film Festivali'nin Genç Başarı Ödülü'ne layık görülmüştü.
Kazım Koyuncu, 25 Haziran 2005'te 33 yaşında kanser nedeniyle hayatını kaybetmişti.

Gençlik ve Spor Bakanı Osman Aşkın Bak, İstanbul'da "Tuzla Belediyesi Spor Kompleksi Temel Atma Töreni"nde konuşuyor.
Tarihindeki ilk maçını 24 Haziran 1936'da Yunanistan'a karşı oynayan Türkiye, 90 yılı aşkın süreçte 1068 karşılaşmaya çıktı. Bu müsabakaların 556'sını kazanan Türkiye, 511'inden mağlubiyetle ayrıldı.
Milli takım, tarihinde bir kez de beraberlik yaşadı. Ay-yıldızlı ekibin 13 Haziran 1995'te İstanbul'da Makedonya ile yaptığı özel maç, 78-78 beraberlikle sonuçlandı.
A Milli Basketbol Takımı, resmi maçlardaki ilk galibiyetini 1949 yılında Mısır'da düzenlenen Avrupa Şampiyonası'nda elde etti.
Turnuvadaki ilk iki mücadelede Yunanistan ve Fransa'ya yenilen Türkiye, üçüncü karşılaşmada Suriye'yi mağlup ederek resmi müsabakalardaki ilk galibiyetine imza attı.
Ay-yıldızlılar, tarihinde en farklı skorlu galibiyetini Libya karşısında elde etti.
İzmir'de düzenlenen İslam Ülkeleri Spor Oyunları'nda 29 Eylül 1980 tarihinde Türkiye, Libya'yı 97 sayı farkla 142-45 yendi.
A Milli Takım, tarihindeki en farklı skorlu yenilgilerini ise Hırvatistan ve Fransa karşısında yaşadı. Milliler, Almanya'da organize edilen 28. Avrupa Şampiyonası'nda, 24 Haziran 1993'te Hırvatistan'a 50 sayı farkla 113-63 mağlup oldu.
Milliler, 3 Temmuz 2024'te Fransa ile deplasmanda oynadığı hazırlık maçında da sahadan 96-46 yenilgiyle ayrıldı.
A Milli Erkek Basketbol Takımı, başantrenör Ergin Ataman ile 106. maçına çıkacak.
Ay-yıldızlılar, Ataman yönetiminde oynadığı 105 müsabakada 59 galibiyet ve 46 yenilgi yaşadı.
